title: A projected site lives under a base path
description:
As a publication owner, I want projection.json `urls.basePath` (for example `"/posts"`) to put the whole projected site under that path, so that one route on a host site's CDN serves it and nothing collides with the host's own files.

Rules:
- Papyrus-generated URLs (pages, listings, tags, archive, feeds, sitemap, robots sitemap line, `_data/*.json`, `.md` twins, `llms.txt`, page actions, islands and component scripts, static files from the static directory, image renditions) live under the base path, and so do their object keys.
- The not-found page stays at the bucket root key `404.html` (the edge distribution's error response reads it); its links use the base path.
- Paths an author writes (nav and footer links, `redirects.exact`, item `aliases`, links inside article bodies) are request paths and are taken as written.
- Projection state under `_papyrus/` is unchanged.
- No base path (the default) changes nothing.

```gherkin
Feature: A standard site projected under a base path

  Background:
    Given a standard site with url style "directory", production URL "https://example.com" and base path "/posts"
    And a published item "hello" with tags "privacy"

  Scenario: Pages and files are stored under the base path
    When the site is projected
    Then the bucket holds "posts/index.html", "posts/hello/index.html" and "posts/tags/privacy/index.html"
    And the bucket holds "posts/css/site.css" from the static directory
    And every object outside "_papyrus/" is under "posts/" except "404.html"

  Scenario: Generated links point under the base path
    When the site is projected
    Then every root-relative href and src that Papyrus generates in "posts/hello/index.html" starts with "/posts/"
    And the canonical URL of "posts/hello/index.html" is "https://example.com/posts/hello/"
    And the home page links to "/posts/hello/"

  Scenario: Feeds, sitemap, public data and agent files use the base path
    When the site is projected
    Then the RSS feed links "https://example.com/posts/hello/"
    And the sitemap lists "https://example.com/posts/hello/"
    And "posts/_data/latest.json" lists "/posts/hello/"
    And "posts/llms.txt" links "https://example.com/posts/hello/index.md"

  Scenario: Paths the author writes are taken as written
    Given a nav link "Home" to "/" and the item has the alias "/posts/old-hello/"
    When the site is projected
    Then the nav link in "posts/hello/index.html" points to "/"
    And the edge redirects "/posts/old-hello/" to "/posts/hello/"

  Scenario: A base path must be a lowercase path
    Given a standard site with base path "/Posts here"
    When the settings are read
    Then they are refused with a message naming urls.basePath
```
